title: The limiting zero counting measure for Eisenstein series
summary: For an arbitrary congruence group $Γ$, we study the zeros of a generating set of the space of Eisenstein series of varying even weight for all $Γ(1)$-conjugates of $Γ$. These zeros form a $Γ(1)$-invariant set that descends to the modular orbifold $Y(1)$. It is known that, as the (even) weight tends to infinity, the set of zeros converges in the Hausdorff metric to finitely many geodesic segments.
